name: In Your Radiant Season
summary: Chan lives every day like it is summer vacation. Haran is trapped in a lonely winter. When their forgotten past reunites them, Chan is determined to gift her another spring. Through laughter and tears, they face winter together and reach their spring in this heartwarming romance.

name: Mud, Sweat and Tears: Premiership Rugby
summary: Mud, Sweat and Tears goes behind the scenes of the best rugby teams in England's Gallagher Premiership as they chase glory after a turbulent season. The series follows the emotional highs and lows of players and coaches as they strive for success. In this most brutal of sports, the playoffs are the culmination of a season's hard sweat and toil, offering the players their chance at sporting triumph.

name: Ram Siya Ke Luv Kush
summary: Sons of Bhagwan Ram and Mata Sita, Luv and Kush grow up in Valmiki's ashram, unaware of their lineage hidden from the truth by Sita.

name: Ancient Worlds Revealed with Albert Lin
summary: National Geographic Explorer, Albert Lin uses high-tech digital equipment to map ancient civilizations revealing never before seen archeological and engineering marvels. His journeys take him throughout Asia, from the tombs of China's first emperor to Mongolia's Forbidden Zone in search of Genghis Khan's burial site. In Nan Madol, Micronesia he finds a quarry in the sky that likely sourced the Saudeleur Dynasty's basalt stone kingdom.

name: Shrimad Bhagwat Mahapuran
summary: In a divine discourse with Radha, Bhagwan Krishna takes it upon himself to explain texts from the ancient and fabled Srimad Bhagwat, sacred in Hinduism, which offers mankind profound spiritual knowledge.

name: Mio Mao
summary: Plasticine animation following the antics of two lively kittens.

name: How to Make a Royal Marines Officer
summary: Two-part documentary following the progress of 29 men who want to become Royal Marine officers.

name: The One Piece
summary: Based on Eiichiro Oda's bestselling manga series, The One Piece follows Monkey D. Luffy, an aspiring pirate who sets sail with his Straw Hats crew in search of the mysterious One Piece treasure. Luffy isn't just like any pirate, however. With limbs that can stretch like rubber, his unique skills help him take on the dangerous villains and rivals that he and his gang encounter at sea.

name: Traitors
summary: The intricate stories of people who committed espionage against the countries or companies they were meant to protect. Featuring tales of betrayal, analyses the secretive methods utilised by the traitors to accomplish their missions, and how intelligence agencies outsmarted them to catch them in the act and bring them to justice.

name: The Kemps
summary: Rhys Thomas interviews Gary and Martin Kemp about their lives and careers .

name: Rick Astley Rocks New Year's Eve
summary: Pop legend Rick Astley is joined by some special guests to put on a spectacular New Year's Eve party, performing a host of his global hits and party tunes.

name: Video・Girl・Ai
summary:
Because Youta worried for another instead of dwelling on his own broken heart, he happened upon a very special video store that only the pure of heart can see. There, he buys what he thinks is a normal erotic video - until a girl climbs out of his television set. Her name is Ai, and thanks to a broken VCR, her personality is a little glitchy. Still, it's her job to help Youta feel better, and perhaps even help him get the girl of his dreams, even if Ai herself might be falling for him as well.

This is an OVA, not a TV show.

name: Lightseeker: The Story of the Young Mao Zedong
Bastard!!: Ankoku no Hakaishin
summary: This six-episode original video animation (OVA) series by AIC cover the story up through the Four Lords of Havoc's battle against Abigail (volumes 6–7 of the manga).

previousepisode.name: 復活のダーク・シュナイダー

name: Angel Sanctuary
summary: Mudou Setsuna, a high school student, loves his sister in a way that he shouldn't. He also struggles from supernatural powers. Angels and demons flocks to him as the day of his awakening draws near -- he is the angel Alexiel, the highest angel which fought against God, reborn.

name: Vivant
summary: Yusuke travels to Balka to recover a $90M overpayment but money has been spread to subcontractors. Betrayed by a taxi driver and stranded in the desert gets caught in a worldwide vortex and the adventure begins.

name: Wakfu: La quête des six Dofus Eliatropes
summary: Six years after the defeat of Qilby, and five years after that of Jiva, the Tofu Brotherhood is forced back into service as the Chaos of Ogrest threatens to overwhelm the Sadida Kingdom. Using the Eliatrope Dofus seems to be the only solution to protect the Sadida people, but a mysterious organization has stolen them and the Tofu Brotherhood must take them back in order to confront Ogrest...

name: Zhongguo Qi Tan
summary: The Chinese Curious Tales has created eight independent stories rooted in Chinese traditional culture respectively because of Shui, Hu Rui, Yang Mu, Liu Maoning, Chen Lianhua and Zhou Xiaolin, Xu Ning, Gu Yang and Liu Kuang, and Pan Bin. It creates an immersive experience of "wonderland dreams, I am in it" with imagination, and leads the audience to meet different "demons".

name: Aeroporto: Área Restrita
summary: The restricted areas of the largest airport in Latin America, through challenging work of the Federal Police and the Internal Revenue Service in protecting the entry and exit from Brazil to the world.

name: Space Files
summary: Short animations that use stunning computer graphic images, time-lapse, simulations and 'real' footage to examine the Earth, the Sun, the Moon and the Solar System.

previousepisode.name: Sun - Powerhouse of the Solar System

name: Indian Police Force
summary: "Indian Police Force" is an action-packed series that follows the harrowing journey of Delhi Police Officer Kabir Malik as he battles an insidious adversary, Zarar, who has chosen the path of terrorism. This cop drama unfolds a thrilling chase, capturing the relentless pursuit of justice and the sacrifices made in the line of duty.

name: Містична Україна
summary: Is it true that terrible monsters live on the territory of Ukraine? How to recognize a geopathogenic zone and avoid its influence? What are bending places, and where exactly in our country most often happen terrible accidents? Do werewolves and vampires really exist? Searching for answers - in a fascinating expedition to the most mysterious places in Ukraine and Crimea. Eyewitness testimonies, comments of scientists and specialists from different spheres will help to reproduce each event in detail to refute or confirm the existence of these or those mystical facts.

name: Jelly Jamm
summary: Jelly Jamm celebrates music, fun, and friendship. Join Bello and his friends in their comedic adventures as they figure out how to live in harmony on the magical Planet Jammbo - origin of music in the universe.

name: Dick Spanner P.I.
summary: In a parallel universe to our own, wisecracking robot private detective Dick Spanner becomes involved in a series of increasingly bizarre cases.

previousepisode.name: The Case of the Maltese Parrot (11)

name: Papa to Musume no Nanokakan
summary: Kawahara Kome is a female high school student and she has feelings for Osugi Kenta. He is the ace player on their school's soccer team. Osugi Kenta is sincere, diligent and a polite young man. He's also popular with the female students. Meanwhile, Kawahara Kome's father is Kawahara Kyoichiro. His performance at work is not very good. Kawahara Kome's relationship with her father is also poor. One day, Kawahara Kome and her father Kyoichiro get involved in an incident and they end up switching bodies. They both struggle to live in the bodies of each other, but they believe they will return to their original bodies. During this time, Osugi Kenta, who is unaware of Kawahara Kome's unusual circumstances, gets attracted to her, but Kawahara Kyoichiro doesn't want his daughter having a romantic relationship with Osugi Kenta.

name: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo
summary:
The Young Kindaichi is back and better than ever! In this first of many cases, Kindaichi finds himself onboard a cruise ship in which the captainmysteriously disappears the day after a big party. A search of the ship finds nothing, except for little drops of blood on the light switch in the captain's room. Might it be a clue perhaps? You bet! When what looks to be a case of serious foul play unfolds, the ship's radio is found disabled—somuch for contacting the authorities. So, far out at sea until they can reach land, it's up to Kindaichi and friends to find the killer…and stay alive!

This is the 2nd generation of Kindaichi Shonen no Jikenbo live-action TV series.

previousepisode.name: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo: Kyuketsuki Densetsu Satsujin Jiken

name: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo R
summary:
High school student Hajime Kindaichi is the supposed grandson of famous private detective Kosuke Kindaichi. Visiting Hong Kong for a fashion event with Kindaichi, our hero's girlfriend Miyuki is captured by a stranger in a case of mistaken identity. The journey to save Miyuki itself leads to yet another crime case.

This is the sequel to the original anime series "Kindaichi Shonen no Jikenbo" from 1996.

previousepisode.name: 狐火流し殺人事件 File.4

name: Acapulco, Cuerpo y Alma
summary:
David Montalvo is a successful businessman enjoying prestige and brightness, plus his gallantry allowed to have any woman he pleases. That success is celebrated as both envied, because although enjoys an excellent relationship with his stepmother and his sister Cinthia and Elena, unable to relate to Marcelo, son of Elena and her first husband.

Marcelo deeply envies and hates David and gradually plans to snatch his wealth and power. In Zihuatanejo, Marcelo meets Lorena Garcia, a waitress at a seaside bar, courting her as David Montalvo until she falls in love with him. A few months later, they marry and then Marcelo and his henchman, German, sabotages a plane David and his associates are travelling in, causing it to crash.

Marcelo confesses the truth to Lorena, forcing her to be his accomplice, because as Lorena believed to be David's widow, she is his sole heir. Marcelo will then inherit David's entire fortune when he married Lorena. However, David survives and returns but is made to believe he has partial amnesia, when he fails to recognise his 'wife'. Slowly falling in love with David, Lorena breaks down and tells him the truth one night during a walk on the beach. David, already in love with Lorena, accepts her as his wife, much to Marcelo's rage. Helped by David's vengeful ex-girlfriend Aide, he sets out to drive the couple apart.

name: Seikimatsu no Uta
summary: Just when about to commit suicide after being deserted by his bride-to-be during the wedding, a man meets a university professor who is also at the point of killing himself. A woman nearby intervenes, one thing leads to another, and the three lost souls move in together. Each episode is a distinct story about the sometimes painful, sometimes warm romances between them and the people they meet while sharing an apartment.

name: Ireland's Fittest Family
summary: Laura Fox is the latest presenter of the exacting reality show, in which families vie to prove they are the fittest in Ireland. They are mentored by Nina Carberry, Donncha O'Callaghan, Davy Fitzgerald and, for the first time ever, Cobh track and field icon Sonia O'Sullivan.

name: Korvessa Kulkevi
summary: After her friend is found murdered in a small fisher village in Northern Finland and the collective suspicion points toward her, bullied outcast Johanna must prove her innocence.

name: Tunel
summary: A tense psychological drama based on police reports depicts the work and lives of members of the negotiating group of the Ministry of Interior Affairs of Serbia, whose work takes place on the border between life and death.

name: Money Movers
summary: Money Movers provides investors with real-time analysis of the stories and the people attracting the attention of the markets each day. Capturing the energy of day's early trading, the program includes the breaking news and numbers driving stocks and sectors, helping investors make critical decisions. "Money Movers" anchors Carl Quintanilla and Sara Eisen speak with the CEOs, government decision-makers and newsmakers who play a relevant role in how money is moving.

name: Комбинация
summary: After the birth of his daughter, Saratov OBKhSS employee Alexander Shishinin decides to radically change his life and do what he has always dreamed of - producing a music group. He meets the talented composer Vitaly Okorokov. Together they literally find the first vocalists on the street: Tatyana Ivanova, Alena Apina and assemble the first female group in the USSR: vocalists and musicians - girls who, with the help of songs, will talk about their difficult fate and about the era.

name: Голодомор. Літописці
summary: "The Holodomor. Chroniclers" is the first documentary attempt to tell everything that is important to know about the Holodomor. It is a chronicle of the most horrific events in the history of Ukraine - a famine that was artificially created by the communist regime of the USSR to destroy the Ukrainian people.

name: Rock Paper Scissors
summary: In Rock Paper Scissors, titular characters, Rock, Paper and Scissors, are a trio of best friends and roommates who lovingly compete over everything in hilarious but mostly wildly absurd ways. Throughout season one, the trio will go to extremes playing hide-and-seek around the world, running from the birthday police, defending the world from an alien invasion, going head-to-head with the Rat Bros and more.

name: The Second Best Hospital in the Galaxy
summary: The Second Best Hospital in the Galaxy follows Dr. Sleech and Dr. Klak - aliens, best friends, and intergalactically renowned surgeons - as they tackle anxiety-eating parasites, illegal time loops, and deep-space STIs.

name: Dipper's Rigs
summary: Join us every week as Dipper embarks on thrilling adventures, riding alongside the giants of the road, exploring the colossal mining and construction equipment, and working with the mammoth farming machinery that defines our nation's prowess. Get ready for an exhilarating journey into the world of massive trucks and machines like never before!

name: Nesting
summary: Anna and Rosa are unlikely best friends for whom the romantic comedy dream hasn't panned out. They have no house, no partner, no baby. At least they have each other. Episode by episode they clumsily, and comically, hunt for a baby daddy to fertilize their drying-up eggs so they can co-parent in a new version of family. All while searching for affordable housing to nest in as, slowly, and surprisingly, their platonic relationship takes a romantic turn - Nesting is a provocative, funny, and unflinching web series about fertility, friendship, the housing crisis, and a mysterious little thing called love.

name: Spice and Spell
summary: "Spice and Spell" revolves around Mon, the owner of a salad shop called "Mon Yum Muan" on Bang Lamung beach. Foodies and customers alike are unanimous in praising the dish as one of the tastiest salads. However, the weak point of this shop is its location, which is difficult for people to find because it is hidden from the crowd. Plus, Mon still refuses to promote the shop via social media. Customers who are hungry for food have to fight with each other to get queue tickets from the people closest to Mon. A mistake causes the story of the delicious salad at the restaurant to attract the attention of Beauty, a famous foodie influencer. She wants to come and record a food review video and sends her personal cameraman named Thos. From that opportunity, Thos will get the secret recipe for a delicious salad, by stealing it.

name: Ruy, El pequeño Cid
summary: The youth of Rodrigo Díaz de Vivar, the historical Spanish hero and nobleman, known as El Cid.

name: Although I Love You, and You?
summary: After his divorce and transferred to Osaka, the only thing Soga thinks about is getting through his day. One of the things that he takes great pleasure in is going to 26-year-old Sakae's resturuant and eating the delicious food he creates. However, he doesn't know that Sakae sees him more than just a frequent customer.

name: NCT Universe: LASTART
summary: Finally, to find the last fixed members of NCT, the journey of "NCT Universe : LASTART" has set sail. Through fierce training, 10 trainees have climbed up the steps to become candidates. "NCT Universe : LASTART" selects the last NCT debut members. Only 4 can become the final member and make it as NCT with SMROOKIES.

name: Karin och Carl Larsson
summary: A series about the Swedish artist couple Karin and Carl Larsson, who during the late 19th century, early 20th century through their creations came to play a big role in what we see as typically Swedish today.

name: Fallen
summary: Fallen follows the story of Luce, a young woman who is sent to a cult-like rehab facility called Sword & Cross to serve time for a crime she can't remember committing. Among the other residents, she encounters the enigmatic Daniel and exasperating but irresistible Cam, all of whom are under the watchful eye of the sinister chief doctor Howson, and devout twin sisters Miriam and Sophia. Luce must untangle the mystery of who she is and why she has a connection to Daniel that goes far back beyond their time in the institution.

name: Neven's Christmas at Adare
summary: Neven Maguire brings his popular Christmas specials from the heart of Co Limerick this year, as he cooks easy and festive dishes in the world-renowned Adare Manor.

name: Off Script with The Hollywood Reporter
summary: Off Script with The Hollywood Reporter showcases a dynamic ensemble of actresses, actors, directors, songwriters and producers and delves deep into the urgent issues, creative methodologies and behind-the-scenes narratives that define the industry. With conversations moderated by The Hollywood Reporter's.

name: The Impact New York
summary: The Impact New York this one-hour unscripted series will give audiences an inside look into the dynamic lives of New York's top influencers in business, music, beauty, and fashion. In addition to witnessing their creative processes, preparations, and high-stakes deal-making, viewers will get to go beyond the perfectly curated social media personas within the cast. "The Impact New York" explores their real-life private and professional struggles as they balance relationships, parenting, and interpersonal drama. For these influencers, everything on the line to stay on top in this competitive world of media impressions, partnerships, and brand perception.

name: Country House Hunters: New Zealand
summary: With the help of Matt Gibb, Kiwi buyers wanting to escape chaotic city living look for their dream homes in the countryside of New Zealand.

name: Zhe Ge Fan Pai Wo Bu Gan Le
Mr. Villain's Day Off
summary:
As a member of a malevolent organization, the General is tasked with invading Earth and wiping out humanity. Even an extraterrestrial being like him, however, needs a chance to rest.

Not even the Rangers—a team solely dedicated to defeating the General and his colleagues—will stand in the way of him visiting pandas at the zoo, buying ice cream at the convenience store, and enjoying his well-deserved day off from committing evil deeds.

name: The Lonely Warrior
summary: The rape and murder suspect dies in the interrogation room due to being beaten up by the crowd earlier. The three teams responsible for this case are also imprisoned together, while the other suspect is still at large. After being released from prison, the three teams, led by their captain Cheng, track down their whereabouts. They pursue the culprit for twelve years.

name: Escort Boys
summary: In Camargue, four guys in dire straits turn to escorting to save their childhood beekeeping estate. Coached by the group's little sister who manages this unique 'business' in the region, they will have to service women and, through their desires... learn to be men of today.

name: Gigolò per caso
summary: Alfonso, a sensitive watchmaker and feminism enthusiast, finds out something that will change his life forever: his father is suddenly back after a heart attack and comes out into the open, telling him that he's not an antique dealer but a gigolo! After a series of unfortunate events, Alfonso is forced to follow his father's path.

previousepisode.name: In amore e a letto tutto è permesso

name: Curse Code
summary: Ake, struggling with finances, lives with grandkids and Am. Krittiya shares a family curse tale, seeks Ake help due to his ancestral ties to rituals against it. Initially reluctant, Ake accepts for compensation. He starts the rituals and gets a golden box but witnesses misfortunes. Spirits appear, grandkids suffer, and Ake races to break the curse to save them.

name: Секрет успеха
summary: Russian version of the British show The X Factor. The show is primarily concerned with identifying singing talent, though personality, stage presence and dance routines are also an important element of many performances.

name: Ture Sventon och den magiska lampan
summary: When Ville Vessla uses a magic lamp to wish away what Ture loves most, he must cooperate with the girl Irma, who needs the lamp to save the life of her sick mother. Together they must stop Ville Vessla from taking over the world with the help of the lamp.

name: The Little Flying Bears
summary: The series focuses on a rare species of little bears with wings that live in the magical forest and protect it from those who want to destroy it.

name: Меломан
summary: Budding legend Dmitry Zhuravlev gathered his friends at his home to sing karaoke songs together. The guests compete with each other in their knowledge of Russian folk pop. It doesn't matter HOW you sing, it matters WHAT you sing!

name: Sabtu Bersama Bapak
summary: Sabtu Bersama Bapak shows the life journey and struggle of a husband and wife, Gunawan and Itje. Knowing that his death is imminent, Gunawan made a series of videos to accompany his two sons, Satya and Cakra. Gunawan instructed Itje to let the sons watch the videos he prepared every Saturday.

name: Induk Gajah
summary: Ira was tired of the arranged marriages that her mother, Mamak Uli, had made, so she decided to agree when she was introduced to Marsel, one of Uli's friend's son. Little that Mamak Uli knows, Ira actually has other plans for this arranged marriage

name: Chasing Flavor
summary: Celebrity chef and best-selling author Carla Hall takes viewers on a global adventure to explore the unexpected roots of popular dishes within today's American food culture on the original Max series Chasing Flavor. Follow along as Carla's curiosity about America's most delicious dishes from chicken pot pie to ice cream leads her to Ghana, Italy, Turkey, and more. Along the way, Carla traces the history and lineage of dishes, discovering the interconnected, international origins and cultures that paved the way for today's American cuisine - because if you don't know the history, then you don't know the dish. Join Carla as she chases flavor across the globe to find out how it all comes together on the American plate.

name: On the Roam
summary: On the Roam follows Jason Momoa as he travels the country chasing art, adventure, and friendship through the lens of craftsmanship.

name: Marriage Badge
summary: A female scriptwriter accidentally travels into her own script in an effort to save her male protagonist. In this unfamiliar world, she encounters various characters, including a shy prince, a sinister rival in love, scheming contenders for the throne, a playful emperor who enjoys matchmaking, a kind-hearted empress, a childhood friend-turn-cousin, and an open-minded mother. The scriptwriter not only has to deal with these complicated personal relationships, but also confront various dangers and challenges. She must find a way to alter the ending of the script to save the one she loves. During this process, she gradually uncovers the secrets and hidden plots behind this world.

name: The Heirloom Recipe
summary: The story tells the story of Zhao Fengpan, a dandy prince who suffers from agesia, and Cheng Biyuan, a tricky cook who runs a stinky tofu stall. The two went from quarreling enemies to sweet lovers who know each other well. In the game, the conspiracy of the court was eliminated, and a lively and delicious relationship was created.

name: Marry's Mission
summary: "Marry", the owner of the beautiful flower shop, was told by her grandfather to hurry up and get married before the age of 30, but... Where will Marry find a man? This job has to be in the hands of "Sunny", the best friend who volunteered to find a man for Marry to look after her.

name: Willie Nelson & Family
summary: The first authorized work exploring the extraordinary life of Willie Nelson traverses the personal and career ups, downs, and in-betweens of one of the world's most beloved musicians.

name: Red Chef Revival
summary: Three chefs explore traditional and contemporary Indigenous cuisine and the dishes of their native lands. Red Chef Revival goes beyond the typical cooking show, revealing a troubled past of racial and social injustice. Using food as their access point, these chefs discover a new path to reconciliation and a deeper understanding of what connects people to food.

name: Hidden Revenge
summary: Shen Qianchu, a disgraced daughter of a prestigious family seeks revenge. She meets Xu Xingbei, the unruly second young master of the Xu family, and despite their initial animosity, they develop a deep affection. Together, they face challenges and betrayals, discovering the true meaning of love and loyalty. Ultimately, they become a married couple, confessing their love and commitment to each other.

name: La tribu et le gourou - Gaïaland
summary: In 1991, a group of people from all over Europe gathered in Scandinavia for an unprecedented ecological adventure: under the leadership of Canadian green guru Pierre Maltais, they wanted to build an alternative future. But what started as a utopia turned into a nightmare.

name: Jizoku Kanona Koi Desuka: Chichi to Musume no Kekkon Koushinkyoku
summary: Kyoka is perfectly happy being single as is her father, Rintaro, a forlorn widower who lost his beloved wife, Yoko, to cancer. One day as the two clean house, they stumble upon a divorce form signed by Yoko. Shocked and reflecting on this revelation, Rintaro at age 63 decides it's time to start over and find himself a life partner. And he challenges Kyoka to do the same. The race to wedding bells is on! in this love story about modern family growth and renewal.

name: Shounen no Abyss
summary: Kurose Reiji is a 17-year-old high school boy whose family members are full of problems. Due to this circumstance, Reiji has no particular dream and wants to get a job instead of going to college to make his mother's life easier. Just as Reiji was spending his days vaguely, he had a fateful encounter with an idol called Aoe Nagi, who proposed to Reiji that they commit suicide together. Will Reiji be able to find the light in his life after all the problems occurring one after another around him?

name: Knockin' on Locked Door
summary: Gotenba Touri is a young man specializes in solving impossible crime tricks (HOW), while Katanashi Hisame specializes in deciphering crime motives and reasons (WHY). Together, they tackle strange and difficult cases under the detective agency "Knockin' on Locked Door".

name: Mei no Mei
summary: When Ozu's older sister and her husband suddenly passed away after an accident, 32-year-old Ozu temporarily moved to Fukushima from Tokyo in order to look after his 12-year-old niece Mei during the summer vacation. He has a modern way of thinking but is lethargic about everything in his daily life. In Fukushima, he meets the local residents who have been living positively with the aim of recovering from the Great East Japan Earthquake, as well as the immigrants who have come from outside of the prefecture in order to realize their aspirations. As he resides alongside his artistic niece, their bond starts to deepen, and through his interactions with Mei and the many residents of Fukushima, he starts to change and grow as a person.

name: Mokomi
summary: Shimizu Mokomi has the ability to understand the feelings of things with no emotions. This includes stuffed toys, stones, and even plants. Due to her mysterious ability, Mokomi has been living in her own world and does not interact with anyone. One day, Mokomi decides to step out of her world and grow up while gathering various experiences. Her sudden change has also influenced her family members who each has their own worries.

name: Sasaki and Peeps
summary: Sasaki, an office worker, buys a bird that can actually give him supernatural powers to cross between worlds. Although he wants to use that power to live in peace, there are various characters who may get in the way of his wishes.

previousepisode.name: Real Life, Fantasy, and the Fourth World

name: Kübra
summary: When a suburban man receives messages that seem to predict the future, he develops a following — and powerful enemies.

name: The Itsy Bitsy Spider
summary: A tomboyish little girl named Leslie McGroarty befriends a four-eyed spider named Itsy, but her teacher Adrienne and the Exterminator and her teacher Adrienne keep trying to rid the world of the arachnid pest.

name: Chaser Game W: Power Harassment Boss Is My Ex-Girlfriend
summary: The story of a game development company employee and her boss, who happens to be her ex-girlfriend.

name: Raffa
summary: Symbol of freedom, queen of TV, LGBTQ+ icon: Raffaella Carrà is a legend that transcends all barriers. This docuseries traces her public and private life, childhood and abandonment by her father, her alleged flirt with Frank Sinatra, crises and rebirths. All told through her most iconic footage, exclusive images from her private archives and never-before-seen testimony of those who really knew her.

name: Dear Detective: From Rampo with Love
summary: At the beginning of the 20th century in Tokyo, the streets are rough, and the people yearn for a hero to emerge. Hirai Taro—who would later become the famed mystery writer Edogawa Rampo—harbors an intense admiration for foreign mystery writers, yet he is still an unknown author who is barely making ends meet by undertaking low-paying jobs. Despite bringing his manuscripts to newspaper publishers, Taro is completely ignored, until he meets Shirai Saburo, an elderly master detective full of humor and melancholy. His strength in the face of adversity impresses Taro, and in turn, Saburo is intrigued by Taro's eccentric ideas and moved by his boundless passion. The two form a partnership and embark on a journey into the world of detective work.

name: Держи Краба
summary: It is not true that fish cannot speak. They sing. And dance. Life underwater is full of sounds and in full swing, we just can't hear it. The sounds of the sea are not what we usually imagine, once you dive into the environment. Fish accumulate not only mercury and harmful substances, but also emotions. An ocean of emotions.

name: LOL: Last One Laughing - Xmas Special (DE)
summary: This year there is a special package under the Christmas tree: LOL, Germany's most successful comedy show, is returning as a special edition at Christmas time! In three episodes, Michael Bully Herbig welcomes eight real LOL all-stars who compete in teams of two. The special thing this time: If one laughs, both are out!

previousepisode.name: Ich sag Santa, du sagst Claus!

name: The Aces
summary: Two billiards geniuses; a street kid with extraordinary talent and a perfectionist from a pool family dynasty. They must compete with each other, pushing themselves to the breaking point to gain honor and find themselves.

name: Sally Bollywood: Super Detective
summary: Sally Bollywood is a 12-year-old girl who, with the help of her neighbour and best friend Doowee, runs a detective agency called S.B.I. - "Sally Bollywood Investigations." Operating out of the Bollywoods' basement, Sally and Doowee make an ideal team. Thanks to Doowee's analytical brain and super gadgets, combined with Sally's detecting and Kalarypayatt skills, the S.B.I. can always solve even the toughest of mysteries!

name: Экстрасенсы. Реванш
summary: In the show "Ekstrasensi. Revansh" participants and finalists of the "Bitva Ekstrasensov" will complete tasks here and now, demonstrating their abilities. And the jury members - the strongest psychics and presenters - will give their verdicts on their work. Each of the participants in the new project at one time had every chance to win, but the audience and the presenters decided otherwise. Victory in the project "Ekstrasensi. Revansh" gives not only the status of the winner, but also automatic entry into the next season of the project "Ekstrasensy. Bitva Sil'neishih" The second place gives you the opportunity to get into the new season of "Bitva Ekstrasensov" without casting.

name: The Strongest Tank's Labyrinth Raids: A Tank with a Rare 9999 Resistance Skill Got Kicked from the Hero's Party
Alchemy Supreme
summary: In the ancient continent of medicine, countless races coexist, with alchemists revered. The Yin-Yang Alchemy God, Su Beihuang, poured his heart and soul into refining the Divine Pill, only to be betrayed by a beautiful woman and become one with the pill, hiding for a century. A hundred years later, his descendant, Su Beitian, suffers humiliation but resists fiercely, unexpectedly inheriting the Alchemy God's legacy and returning with overwhelming power! Awakening his dual-elemental martial veins of ice and fire, he re-cultivates the Alchemy God's techniques, becoming a young hero. As he investigates the truth behind his mother's disappearance, a series of conspiracies gradually surface. Witness Su Beitian overcome tribulations, unravel the ultimate martial arts, and become the supreme master of alchemy!

name: A Shop for Killers
summary: Set in modern-day Korea, A Shop For Killers sees college student Jung Ji Ahn diving for cover in her childhood home after a series of highly skilled assassins get her in their sights. Desperately fighting to survive, Ji Ahn will begin to remember invaluable lessons her uncle taught her before his apparent suicide, drawing on them to help her stay alive. Confused and cornered, Ji Ahn will have to work fast to uncover her uncle's hidden past and figure out why so many people are desperate to gain access to the house and the extensive arsenal hidden inside.

name: Doctor Slump
summary: A rom-com about doctors who are in a slump as they try to resuscitate their lives. Their story captures the love and growth of two characters who live in a rooftop house after quitting their jobs as doctors.

name: Captains of the World
summary: From the locker room to the pitch, this docuseries offers exclusive access to all 32 teams as they fight for football glory in the 2022 FIFA World Cup.

name: Ιστορίες από την Απέναντι Όχθη
summary: An anthology series of horror & sci-fi stories.

name: 7 Θανάσιμες Πεθερές
summary: An anthology series involving stories of several different mothers in law where each story consists of 3 episodes, except 7th season that each story consists of 2 episodes.

name: Zénith
summary: Véronique Cloutier revealed to us this morning the identity of the four captains who will be the spokespersons for the public in the studio on her new show, Zénith, on the air next January. It is the public who will have the task of voting for the best performance presented at Zénith. Each generation will have its own captain.

name: Itsudatte my Santa
summary: An unlucky boy named Santa was born on Christmas Eve whose parents don't even care about meets a santa- in- training girl name Mai. She is determined to wish him the best Christmas he will ever have and its gets even better when they fall in love with each other. Mai, a Santa in training, appears in front of an Unlucky boy named Santa, on Christmas Eve, promising him, she will make him happy for one night.

name: Dharti Ka Veer Yodha Prithviraj Chauhan
summary: The historical story begins with the childhood of Prithviraj.It shows how he became the king.The begins the epic love story of Prithviraj and Sanyogita and how Mohammed Ghor attack Delhi.

name: Cartoon Sushi
summary: Following the tradition of MTV's previous animation show Liquid Television, this show was basically a collection of various animated shorts made by a variety of different cartoonists.

name: Les contes de la rue Broca
summary: Cartoon adaptation of tales written by Pierre Gripari.

name: Gawayn
summary: in the mystical city of Camelot, William is an optimistic knight-in-training who is devoted to his mentor, knight in gleaming armour, Sir Roderick. The complication starts when the evil Duke of Amaraxos shrinks Princess Gwendolyn and takes over the kingdom, so the friends accompanied with Elspeth, an 11 year old apprentice sorceress and Xiao Long, a young sage-in-training from distant Asia, set off on an adventure to undo the terrible curse.

name: Love Behind the Melody
summary: Li Sasa, the chief pipa performer, was performing on stage with a charismatic performance. By chance, a phoenix-necked pipa dragged her into the prosperous dynasty a thousand years ago and became an abandoned woman pipa girl. Living on the streets of Shangjing, she lives in Youjiaofang by accident, and becomes attached to Lu Jingnian, the head of Youjiaofang who is surrounded by Yingyan in the market. With full of "love field" and "qin field" skills, Li Sasa gradually made Lu Jingnian look at him differently. The two joined hands with friends such as Xiner and Yu Shijie to create the Shengchao Women's Heavenly Troupe. During the process, the love between the two continues to spread, and who will confess first when they are on the verge of ambiguity?

name: That Cover Girl
summary: Sofi is a popular muslim modest wear fashion designer and influencer who's the talk of the town thanks to her provocative fashion show at Paris Fashion Week. As a dynamic modern woman, Sofi sees herself as a self-starter, a savvy and fearless business woman. Her dream is to take modest wear to new heights, and she is unapologetic to her detractors.

name: Rencana Besar
summary: Three bank employees are suspected of embezzling 17 billion rupiahs. A detective named Makarim comes to investigate and realizes there is a much bigger scandal within the bank than just the missing money.

name: A+
summary: Battling from the try out ranks to break into first place, Kaliypso Dirgantari must face the top four throne-holders at Bina Indonesia High School: Re Dirgantara, Kenan Aditya, Adinda Aletheia and Aurora Calista. Each propelled by their own motivations, the five fiercely compete for parallel rankings, at least until an epic secret related to the school system is exposed.

name: Tukar Tambah Nasib
summary: Naya lives and grows in an environment full of misery and endless problems. It's in this dark moment that Master offers Naya the opportunity to exchange her fortune. Naya visits the Fortune Exchange Store and tries the lives of businessman Sato, politician Meri, chef Riko, and ballerina Lala. As part of their lives, Naya discovers many shortcomings and intricate problems within the lives.

name: You'll Never Walk Alone
summary: Xia Yuan, an executive of a travel company, got engaged to her boyfriend Song Hangyu on her 30th birthday. It was a great harvest in both career and love. But at the engagement party, Song Hangyu disappeared. Xia Yuan found out that Song Hangyu had gone abroad, so he dropped everything and gave himself a year to look for Song Hangyu. On the other hand, Hao Weiwei, who had a relationship with Xia Yuan in Shanghai, was arranged by his father to go abroad to work and train due to the bankruptcy of his father's company. Ye Siqi, a girl born in 1995, and Qiao Bin, who grew up in Shanghai, got married and divorced. Ye Siqi, who was hot-headed and wanted to pursue a new life, also embarked on a journey. Qiao Bin, who regretted the divorce, followed Ye Siqi's footsteps and went abroad. They met by chance and went on the road together.

name: I Don't Want to Be The Princess
Mirage Pavilion
summary: In the previous life, the sisters Man Zhu and Sha Hua were beautiful and powerful in the divine world. When Man Zhu experienced the disaster, she suffered a counterattack. Sha Hua saved Man Zhu and thus suffered a natural disaster. Man Zhu ignored the pain of her body and went to save Sha Hua. Sha Hua could not see her sister suffering and decided to sacrifice herself. The god was moved by the emotions of the two sisters and decided to give them a chance to meet when the red magic lily bloomed on the other side. But they agreed to "not recognize each other" between meetings. Man Zhu waited again and again, and finally saw Sha Hua, who had lost her memory in the world, but at this time, Sha Hua was already a mortal, named Qian Xia, who was the chief constable of the pure evil department. After the appearance of Man Zhu, there was a legend in the bustling Guangling City. There was a place in the city called the Magic Mirror Pavilion. Its owner was a mysterious woman in red. It is said that as long as you have a wish to realize it, she can help you complete it. The price of realizing the wish is to exchange it with her with your "one thought", and Qian Xia was also involved in investigating murders, and embarked on a case investigation journey with the beautiful owner Man Zhu.

name: Castle in the Time
summary: Meeting between a paleontology student and an established actor, resulting in a romance. Xu Zhen, optimistic and determined, seeks to reconcile her ailing parents by getting a job at, where her mother is a director. There, she witnesses Chi Jun's rejection by his ex-girlfriend. To protect his wounded ego, Chi Jun tries to push Xu Zhen away, but she wins his heart and becomes her personal assistant. However, Xu Zhen discovers a conspiracy at the company, putting it in danger.

name: 'Tis Time for "Torture," Princess
summary: As the war between the Imperial Army and Hellhorde rages on, the Princess, despite being armed with her mythical sword Excalibur, is captured and imprisoned. What kind of torture does she face at the hands of the chief demon interrogator? Fluffy fresh-baked toast! Hot, steaming ramen! Oh, the humanity! Can the Princess withstand these tormenting treats and keep her kingdom's secrets safe?

name: As Aventuras de Gui & Estopa
summary: The misadventures of Gui and Estopa, two young anthropomorphic dogs and their friends the dog Cróquete, the pitbull Piti Burro, the girl Fifi and the rat Riba.

name: Nicolas Noël : Les plus grands secrets de Nicolas Noël
summary: How does Santa Claus manage to go through chimneys and travel around the world in a single night? How many reindeer pull his sleigh? Why does Rudolph have a red nose? Does the big book of good children really exist? Does Santa take a vacation? It's the real Santa Claus who answers all these intriguing questions - and many more - in the all-new series. In a magical world, accompanied by Grésille, a mischievous and sensitive elf, Nicolas Noël tells the mysteries that surround the magic of Christmas. Young and old will be dazzled, amazed and touched by his fantastic stories and catchy songs.

name: Who Owns Scotland?
summary: Martin Geissler travels to towns and cities across Scotland to discover where responsibility lies when it comes to owning urban land.

name: Finally Caught
summary: With homicide cold cases leaving unanswered questions for the victims' loved ones, killers are able to run free with the assumption they've gotten away with murder. Whether it's due to botched investigations, lack of evidence, or science not evolving fast enough, these bumps along the road have left us demanding justice for the people they've affected. In order to tell their stories, the concept of this true crime show centers around bringing these cold cases back to life through experts and material witnesses to ensure the killers are... Finally Caught.

name: Born to Cook: Jack Stein Down Under
summary: Jack Stein is the young chef at the helm of the generation of Brits shaking up the restaurant scene. Quick, charming and ever-so deprecatingly British, Jack has recently taken charge of the nine restaurants under the Stein brand conceived by his celebrity father Rick.

name: Znam kako dišeš
summary: A single mother of a teenager in the midst of a divorce, Nevena Murtezic struggles to balance her life between her 17-year-old son, Dino, and a job constantly under pressure from politics and the public.

name: Red Cat Ramen
summary: Welcome to Ramen Akaneko, a restaurant run solely by cats. That is, until a human named Tamako Yashiro interviews for a job. Oddly enough, her candor about being a dog person lands her the job. This is a beautiful story of human and feline relationships woven through the many customers who visit Ramen Akaneko. Get ready for an extra helping of heartfelt moments that warm the body and soul.

previousepisode.name: Choose the Team! / As Always, Thanks for Coming / Congratulations

name: Ponto Final
summary: Ivan, a clandestine van driver, navigates the end of his marriage and daily challenges with humor in this quirky comedy series featuring a live audience.

name: Mighty Bheem's Playtime
summary: Bheem, a fun-loving toddler with incredible strength, is heading to school. Join his classroom adventures as he makes new friends and plenty of mischief!

name: Kopuk
summary: Set in Tarlabaşı, Istanbul, the show will follow a modern-day Robin Hood and his accomplice John as they steal from the rich to give the poor.

name: Vyooham
summary: A newly appointed police officer is assigned to a hit and run case, where a pregnant couple lost their child. What seems like a simple open and shut case, turns out to be a complicated web involving several seemingly unconnected people. To solve the case, the officer has to hunt down a serial killer, a trained naxal, a suspended cop, and a terrorist organization, while facing his own painful past.

name: Building Outside the Lines
summary: Innovative builder Jared "Cappie" Capp transforms unexpected objects into beautifully designed structures with the most creative person he knows -- his teenage daughter.

previousepisode.name: A Family Legacy: From Motel to Orchard House

name: You Can't Hide Your Heart
summary: The governor Murong Zang originally wanted to train his enemy's daughter Yunjiao to become his trump card against his enemies, but he gradually fell in love with her day and night and couldn't help but fall in love with her, thus falling into a struggle between love and hate.

name: Tom-tom et Nana
summary: The cartoon covers the Dubouchon family, proprietors of the restaurant The Good Fork, which is often turned upside-down by the mischief of the two youngest children, Tom-Tom and Nana. New heroes were created: Anatole Latuile and Ariol, who are now the main characters.

name: Perfect Propose
summary: Hirokuni Watari, a cog in the corporate machine, faints on the street one day and ends up meeting Kai Fukaya, someone he hasn't seen in twelve years. With Kai having no place to stay, he ends up staying with Hirokuni and making home-cooked meals for him to soothe his exhaustion.

name: Παγιδευμένοι
summary: A murder joins the path of two people, trapping them in a sea of shocking revelations. Caught in a whirlwind of life-changing events, they search for truth and redemption.

name: America's Caddie
summary: Covering professional golf like fans have never seen it before, America's Caddie mixes feature segments and interviews with golf's biggest stars, as the series follows Collins on his journeys across the country. Part travelogue, part golf history lesson, part celebrity hangout – America's Caddie combines it all into a magazine-style road show hosted by the one-of-a-kind Collins.

name: Helgoland 513
summary:
It's 2036 and Helgoland has become the last safe haven for humanity. A small community of survivors are entrenched on Germany's only deep-sea island following an apocalypse that has thrown the rest of the world into chaos. A totalitarian society is established, tolerating only 513 people on the island at any one time.

The survivors trapped on the island have limited resources to share and an inhumane social-ranking system determines the lives of each of the 513 inhabitants. Helgoland's only doctor is high on the priority list, whilst others are far behind and have to fight for a better place and, their ultimate survival. But they face another threat from the outside. On the mainland, a group of rebels are preparing to conquer the island and disrupt the last safe place for mankind.

name: Papa Beaver's Story Time
summary: Papa Beaver's Storytime is an animated television series tells of a single father beaver of three little beaver children of his own, two sons and one daughter, who would tell them different stories, either a fable or a fairytale to his children and at the end would tell them the moral of the story to teach them a lesson about their actions that have done before the story began.—rocknrollunderdawg

name: Milkshake! Bop Box Boogie
summary: Whatever the mood, Milkshake! presenters take viewers through all the moves.

name: Riding Britain's Railways
summary: Climb up on the footplate and join historian and host Dan Cruickshank for a railway adventure like no other as he investigates how trains helped shape modern Britain. This three-part series resurrects an exhilarating age and kicks off by focusing on the railways' role in defeating Hitler, before unearthing the incredible engineering achievements of Isambard Brunel and embarking on a trip on the earliest steam engines.

name: Home in Hawaii
summary: Designer Shaolin Low infuses a modern Hawaiian twist on homes throughout the islands. With the help of her contractor dad, Albert, and her craftsman husband, Leaf, the family is redefining the look and feel of being home in Hawaii.

name: Restoring Galveston: The Inn
summary: Michael and Ashley Cordray restore a 1912 boarding house, adding custom elements along the way to transform it into a one-of-a-kind hotel in Galveston, Texas.

name: RWBY VTubing
summary: "RWBY VTubing" is an animated V-tuber series featuring Ruby Rose doing a vlog

name: Le Club des 5 : Nouvelles enquêtes
summary: A new and modern adaptation of the Famous Five books written by Enid Blyton.

previousepisode.name: The Case of the Golden Medal and the Horse of Steel

name: Мастер кондитер
summary: Renat Agzamov, a legend in the world of pastry chefs, opens his academy. He will become a teacher and mentor for the best and most talented bakers and roosters from all over the country. Which of them will receive the highest title in the confectionery business and become a master pastry chef?

name: Get Ready!
summary: This dark medical drama examines the meaning of human life, centring on a team of unidentified black-market doctors who undertake any kind of surgery with superhuman surgical skills and exorbitant medical expenses.

name: Ayali
summary: Tamil Selvi, a teenager, struggles with her dreams of becoming a doctor in the oppressive village of Veerappannai. Will she be able to break the 500-year-old custom that bars women's education?

name: Bazaar Beloved Birds
summary: Yu Xixi and Yu Chao grew up under the same roof. Yu Chao was reserved and rarely smiled, sticking to his principles; while Yu Xixi was lively, mischievous, and free-spirited. Their mother entrusted both the Will Immortal Tower and the Yu family to Yu Chao before her passing. Simultaneously, she urged Yu Chao to marry Yu Xixi as soon as possible, hoping that the two could support and take care of each other in the future. However, the two harbored mutual displeasure towards each other. Simultaneously, a scandal from fifteen years ago resurfaced in the martial world, adding complexity to the situation with intricate martial forces, grudges, and romantic entanglements. Amidst conflicts and struggles, Yu Xixi and Yu Chao found redemption, discovering their own path in the martial world. As the martial world returned to calm, Yu Xixi and Yu Chao returned to the Will Immortal Tower, renaming it "Zhao Xi Tower" by taking one character from each of their names. They didn't seek treasures or titles; they only wished to live a fulfilling and joyful life in the midst of a vibrant world.

name: Sunshine Getaways with Amanda Lamb
summary:
Property expert Amanda Lamb, presenter and JLS star JB Gill, and DJ and presenter Sam compete to find their favourite holiday rental, searching a new area to find a holiday home to champion.

Plus, to keep them on their toes, there will be a fourth "mystery" property that none of them have seen. They discuss the pros and cons, and then score.

name: STHLM Blackout
summary: The action is set to a backdrop of Sweden facing primitive power outages and ominous predictions about the coming winter. Reluctant widower Arthur gets recruited to help his colleague, star journalist Cristina, who dares to question the mainstream narrative. Feeling cornered by the police and other powers, he becomes her partner-in-crime, in the craziest, most hazardous day of his life — the only problem being he has a date with Mille, and as not to arouse any suspicion, it needs to happen as planned.

name: Mercy for None
summary: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death -- embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

name: Sans issue : La tuerie de Chevaline
summary: On September 5, 2012, in a small mountain car park near Lake Annecy and the village of Chevaline, three members of a family of British vacationers and a local cyclist were murdered, shot to death. Dozens of shell casings litter the ground. This tragedy marks the beginning of one of the most sprawling and mysterious criminal cases of recent decades in Europe, which has still not been elucidated despite extensive investigations and modern means put in place.

name: Wedding.con
summary: Wedding.con is a true crime documentary series about five women who seek to fulfill a universal dream - Marriage. However, in their search for the perfect life-partner, they end up getting exploited financially and emotionally by conmen with fake identities, posing as suitable grooms on popular online platforms.

name: The Voice of Finland: All Stars
Secrets of the Enchanted Forests
summary: Traverse the planet's richest, most diverse woodlands, from the tropics to the poles and everywhere in between. Get to know the wild residents of these magical ecosystems and learn how forests connect and nurture the lives of countless species.

name: The Dirty D
summary: What happens when you mix drugs, money, sex, and drama with beautiful, money hungry, conniving Bottle Girls, inside one of Detroit's hottest nightclubs ran by a shady power couple.

name: Musti
summary: Make friends with Musti, the happy little kitten who is always having a new adventure.

name: Кинопоиск: Топ-250 фильмов
summary: A series about the best films according to Kinopoisk. In each episode, we talk about the audience's favorite movie and analyze how it works and why it changed the history of cinema.

name: Almost Unsolved
summary: Almost Unsolved is a true crime series that explores murder cases where investigations stalled or went cold; often for decades. Featuring interviews with the experts and law enforcement officials who worked these cases along with dramatic re-enactments we follow detectives, scientists and even amateur sleuths that dedicate their lives to bringing justice and closure to the cases that nearly went unsolved... Almost.

name: Kill Me Love Me
summary: What can a person do for survival? Others may not know, but Mei Lin is willing to sacrifice everything, including her body and dignity. She yearns for life to bloom recklessly like spring flowers in February, even if it's brief. However, in reality, she lives like a toad in the mud, hiding away, ugly and dirty. All she knows is that with life, other things can be discussed. If even life is gone, what else is there to talk about? Yet, she never expected that, in the end, she would fall into the hands of Murong Jin and that bastard – the man who once treated her as a plaything to please another woman and was harshly repaid by her. That man, who is narrow-minded and holds grudges, turned out to be her final downfall.

name: Later, I Laughed
summary: At 26 years old, Xiao Ya works for a large corporation. She tends to accommodate others and doesn't express her own opinions, making others comfortable but suppressing herself. In the eyes of others, her life seems great; she has a stable job and a motivated boyfriend. However, Xiao Ya knows she is forcing herself into an uncomfortable situation, just barely holding on. When her boyfriend, Zheng Hao, made three major life decisions for her: changing her job, proposing, and deciding on their housing without consulting her, will Xiao Ya finally break her silence?

name: Ming's Dynasty
summary: Aspiring rappers Whyte Wine (Calwyn Shurgold) and Young Riesling (Antony Hall) are forced to give up their dream of making it big in Toronto when Riesling has to return to rural Alberta to manage his family's restaurant, the Ming Ho Garden.

previousepisode.name: Big Trouble In Little Chinese Restaurant

name: Hustlers Gamblers Crooks
summary: Hustlers Gamblers Crooks features true stories of high-stakes hustlers, gamblers, and crooks told by those who lived them. Structured like a Hollywood thriller, it's packed with gut-wrenching moments. Root for these underdogs who risk it all to change their futures.

name: Zatoka szpiegów
summary: Franz Neumann is a young Abwehr officer who discovers his Polish origins and decides to become an Allied spy.

name: Xi yang yang yu hui tai lang
summary: In the year of 3131 Goat calendar, the goats are living happily and peacefully on Green-Green Grassland until the wolf couple moves to the forest on the opposite side of the shore.

name: Rezidentai
summary: Lithuanian adaption of cult Russian sitcom "Interny"

name: Alexander: The Making of a God
summary: Combining expert interviews with gripping reenactments, this docudrama explores the life of Alexander the Great through his conquest of the Persian Empire.

name: Judge Romesh: Justice Never Sleeps
summary: Judge Romesh presides over genuine court cases brought to him by the British public. There's no case too big, too small, or too weird as he dispenses his own style of court room justice.

name: A Home Away
summary: Design duo Bryan and Catherine Williamson are taking on their biggest project yet – renovating and operating a Queen Anne bed and breakfast in Columbus, Ohio.

name: War: Wrath and Revenge
summary: Nuhu Bula looks set to be the next governor of Kowa. Until his wife learns he wants to marry another woman — and does everything she can to stop him.

name: Heil Honey I'm Home!
summary: Suburban dwellers, Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun, are less than pleased to discover that their new neighbours, the Goldensteins, are Jewish.

name: The Changemakers
summary: The Changemakers is a new 8-part series to illuminate amazing stories from across the globe, where communities are working together for a better future.

name: Això no és Suècia
summary: Follows Mariana and Samuel who move to a mountain neighborhood away from their traumatic childhoods, but their beliefs start to crumble when a tragic event rocks the neighborhood and shatters their dreams.

name: LOL: Den der ler sidst
summary: 100.000 DKK for a charitable purpose is at stake, when ten of Denmark's funniest comedians compete to be the last one laughing in a competition where you're not allowed to laugh.

name: The Sunday Show with Jonathan Capehart
summary: On The Sunday Show with Jonathan Capehart, host and Washington Post Columnist Jonathan Capehart examines the high stakes surrounding key issues affecting communities across America. Drawing upon his years of experience covering Washington politics through four presidents, Capehart cuts through the political noise to bring you compelling, in-depth interviews and unique perspectives.

name: Superhot: The Spicy World of Pepper People
summary: Superhot spicy peppers are on fire lately - but while most experiment with heat, others live their lives in pursuit of fire. Superhot is a wild ride into the Spicy World of Pepper People - the self-proclaimed chili heads who have taken the chili pill and want to find out how deep the rabbit hole goes. This 10-part series goes deep into a subculture fueled by spice: from the elite growers who strive to create new superhots to the chili eaters who chase the endorphin rush of consuming them. Along the way, one legendary chili head sets out on a quest to answer the spiciest of questions: is there a pepper that can challenge the world's hottest?

name: B.R.I. La série documentaire
summary: Men and women from the BRI, an elite police unit, recount the unfolding of several of the most delicate operations.

name: Conan and the Young Warriors
summary:
A time of wizards, warriors and kings. From this time of fantasy and magic strides Conan. He is a warrior, an adventurer, a conqueror, a hero and a legend.

Conan's phenomenal strength overcomes the most dangerous situations he faces. He lives by a chivalrous code that values loyalty, honesty and fairness.

Naive in the ways of the world, but filled with boundless energy and youthful enthusiasm, Conan's fabulous quest takes him from untamed hills to trackless jungles to insurmountable mountains, frigid glaciers and rushing rivers. He encounters scheming sorcerers, treacherous snake men and winged creatures. He befriends powerful warriors and seafaring pirates.

Conan is a man of action - direct, blunt, fearless and ever willing to combat sorcery. Conan's phenomenal strength and courage conquer any enemy.

name: The Bannocking
summary: A mysterious sickness quickly spreads a small community as an estranged family struggles to come together.

previousepisode.name: The Good, the Bad, and the Bannock

name: A Place in the Sun: What Happened Next?
summary: Property experts catch up with previous house-hunters who bought their perfect place abroad and get a glimpse of what their lives are like living in the sun.

name: The Joe Schmo Show
summary: Hosted by Cat Deeley, this show within a show takes aim at the absurdity of reality TV by making a regular guy believe he is competing on a reality show, when he is in fact, surrounded by a cast of highly skilled improv comedians.

name: Brits Down Under
summary: A bunch of intrepid young backpacking Brits head deep into the Australian Outback for some intense manual labour. If they can complete 88 days of labour, they could earn extensions to their working holiday visas.

name: Michael Mosley: Secrets of Your Big Shop
summary: Dr Michael Mosley uncovers what could be behind our health by looking into our shopping trolleys.

name: HMP Belmarsh: Evil Behind Bars
summary: Former inmates, retired prison staff and experts discuss stories from life inside London's toughest high security prison.

name: Secret Life of the Safari Park
summary: Secret Life of the Safari Park gets up close at Knowsley Safari, where the greatest and rarest species on earth roam free, from baboons to buffalo, to rhinos and lions

name: Malta: The Jewel of the Med
summary: Malta: The Jewel of the Med celebrates the life, culture, and beauty of one of Europe's most astonishing countries, exploring every aspect of Malta and meeting the colourful characters, both British and Maltese, who live there.

name: The Little Red Matchmaker
summary: Five hundred years ago, Hong Luan and Tian Xi, two deities, battled against the nine-tailed fox. To protect Hong Luan, Tian Xi decided to exhaust a thousand years of soul power to seal away the nine-tailed fox. After that, Hong Luan lost her memory and became Liu Yingying, a matchmaker working for Yue Lao, a god of marriage and love. Hong Luan won the heart of Jiang Changqing, a reincarnated immortal under the Heartless Curse. Meanwhile, the nine-tailed fox was on the verge of breaking through its seal. A story about three lives of love trials unfolds.

name: 90 Day Fiancé: Pillow Talk - Holiday Specials
summary: Join us for a festive extravaganza as your 90 Day favorites embrace the holiday spirit. It's not just the costumes and decorations that are over-the-top -- our Pillow Talkers hold nothing back as they react to outrageous 90 Day moments.

name: The Lost Brides
summary: Shen Mansion's young lady, Chu Qi, heard that her sister, Shen Shisan, who had been inseparable from her since childhood, went missing while searching for a specific medicine. In a desperate situation, she had a conflict with the medicine vendor Wang Wu. Chu Qi was rescued by Gu Yusheng, the son of a military officer and her childhood friend. Wang Wu fled, but mysteriously died that night. The investigating officer, Wu Xu, guided by clues, identified Chu Qi as the suspect. Driven by her concern for her missing sister, Chu Qi broke into the charity house at night to search for clues on Wang Wu's body. The clues pointed to a place called "Fengming Town." Coincidentally, Wu Xu, who came to inspect the body, apprehended Chu Qi. In a struggle, Chu Qi accidentally tore her clothes. Wu Xu, in an unexpected gesture, lent her his own clothes and accidentally dropped his police badge. Chu Qi successfully entered Fengming Town under the identity of "Officer Wu." However, the village was shrouded in mystery, and villagers Chu Qi had interacted with died under strange and eerie circumstances. In a desperate situation, Officer Wu Xu and Gu Yusheng successively arrived at Fengming Town. They experienced various bizarre and mysterious events, gradually uncovering the truth behind the villagers' deaths. The tragic fate of Shen Shisan became clearer, and subtle changes occurred in the relationships among the three individuals. However, they were unaware that they had become the targets of a hidden puppeteer.

name: Love on Lo
summary: When the good-natured Golf is tasked with exploring locations, he meets the callous Pond. The two end up in a situation where they are forced to share a hotel room and their differences provoke new feelings in each other.

name: Rüzgarlı Tepe
summary: Zeynep is the smart, well-behaved, exemplary daughter of the wealthiest family in the town where she lives, while Halil is a young man who lost his mother and father at an early age and lives with his aunt with a grudge to avenge his family. These two young people who live despite their families will find themselves in an unthinkable blind knot.

name: Téléchat
summary: Téléchat is a news show parody hosted by a tomcat named Groucha (who always had his arm in plaster) and an ostrich named Lola.

name: Snack Basue
summary: Welcome to Snack Basue! Delight yourself in this charming snack bar, just five stations away from Hokkaido's largest downtown area, Susukino. Run by the quirky proprietress, Basue, and her junior hostess, Akemi, the place is filled with laughter and smiles from its oddball regulars and walk-ins as they regale tales of their lives. So, pull up a seat and have a drink—is shochu OK?

previousepisode.name: Risen' To the Top / Just One Look

name: Sons of the Caliphate
summary: Sons of the Caliphate follows the lives of three rich, entitled, passionate and ambitious young men, Kalifah, Nuhu and Diko, all caught up in the hidden corners of power, the darkness of addiction, the heat of love and desire, the obligations of family loyalty, and the craving for revenge.

name: Me, Eloise
summary: Eloise is an imaginative little girl living in New York City with her nanny, going on various adventures.

name: Berättelsen Om Killinggänget
summary: The comedy group Killinggänget made a big splash in the 90s with, among other things, "Nilecity" and "I manegen med Glenn Killing". In "Berättelsen om Killinggänget" they themselves tell about their life in the 30-year-old comedy group.
